rows.question: What is the minimum health insurance premium in Lausanne for an adult?
notes: Assumed an adult aged 30 (adult rate from age 26)
Assumed the 300 CHF franchise (deductible), the standard one; a higher franchise lowers the premium
rows.answer:
1. To find the minimum health insurance premium in Lausanne for an adult, look at the premiums listed on the source map. The cheapest option WITHOUT accident cover is 531.7 CHF (Sanitas, TelMed (Compact One)). 
2. If you want accident cover, the cheapest option is 570.1 CHF (Atupri, HMO).
3. Compare these prices with other insurers to find the best deal. You can compare offers on the websites of the insurers or on an online comparison tool.
4. Next step: Compare the options on the official insurer websites or on an online comparison tool to find the best deal for you.

rows.question: Quelle est la prime minimale d'assurance maladie à Lausanne pour un adulte ?
notes: Assumed an adult aged 30 (adult rate from age 26)
Assumed the 300 CHF franchise (deductible), the standard one; a higher franchise lowers the premium
rows.answer:
1. La prime minimale d'assurance maladie pour un adulte à Lausanne en 2026 est de 531.7 CHF (sans couverture d'accident) avec l'assureur Sanitas, modèle TelMed (Compact One). 
2. Si vous souhaitez une couverture d'accident, le minimum est de 570.1 CHF avec l'assureur Atupri, modèle HMO. 

Pour comparer les offres, visitez [https://www.kvgmapper26.github.io/maps/](https://www.kvgmapper26.github.io/maps/) et sélectionnez votre commune de Lausanne.

rows.question: Je viens d'arriver d'Allemagne pour travailler, quel permis de séjour me faut-il ?
rows.answer:
1. Pour travailler en Suisse, vous avez besoin d'un permis de séjour. 
2. Votre permis dépendra de votre nationalité et de la raison de votre séjour. 
3. Vous trouverez des informations supplémentaires sur l'accord de libre circulation sur le site de SEM (Service des migrations).
4. Pour obtenir un permis, vous devrez passer par les autorités cantonales de migration.

Pratique prochaine étape: Pour connaître les détails spécifiques à votre situation, consultez le site officiel de SEM. 

Par exemple, pour comparer les offres de permis de séjour, allez sur le site de SEM et recherchez la section "Permis de séjour pour les citoyens de l'UE/AELE".

rows.question: How many signatures does a federal popular initiative need?
rows.answer: A federal popular initiative requires 100,000 valid signatures to be valid. The collection period is 18 months. The source is the Swiss Federal Chancellery website (https://www.bk.admin.ch/de/volksinitiativen).

rows.question: Chi può votare alle elezioni del Consiglio nazionale?
rows.answer:
Secondo la legislazione federale svizzera, possono votare alle elezioni del Consiglio nazionale i cittadini elvetici che hanno compiuto 18 anni. La legge federale non disciplina le elezioni del Consiglio degli Stati, che dipendono dal diritto cantonale.

rows.question: Wie viel Mehrwertsteuer zahle ich auf ein Paket im Wert von 200 Franken aus dem Ausland?
notes: Dropped vat_rate '8.1%' after a tool error
rows.answer: Auf ein Paket im Wert von 200 Franken aus dem Ausland wird standardmässig eine Mehrwertsteuer von 8,1 % erhoben. Die geschätzte Mehrwertsteuer beträgt 16,2 Franken. Diese Berechnung basiert auf dem Wert des Pakets und berücksichtigt keine zusätzlichen Gebühren wie Zollgebühren oder Postweiterleitungsgebühren. Die Quelle dieser Informationen ist die Website des Bundesamts für Zoll und Grenzsicherheit (https://www.bazg.admin.ch/en/receipt-of-letters-and-parcels).

rows.question: What is the current reference interest rate for rents?
rows.answer: As of 2 September 2026, the reference interest rate for rents in Switzerland is 1.25%. This rate is unchanged since 2 September 2025 and determines the maximum increase in rent based on the rent index. The average interest rate used in the rent index is 1.31%, as of 30 June 2026. The next publication of the reference rate is expected on 1 December 2026. - BWO/UFAB, 1 September 2026

rows.question: Can I exchange my US driving licence in Zurich?
notes: Dropped fact_type 'exchange' (allowed: all, fee, deadline, requirement)
rows.answer:
1. To exchange your US driving licence in Zurich, you must first have lived in Switzerland for at least 12 months.
2. You must also not have spent more than three consecutive months abroad during that period.
3. For non-EU/EFTA professional driving, you need to get the Swiss licence before your first professional drive.
4. You need to pass an eye test, which remains valid for two years.
5. If required, you might need to take a control drive, which costs CHF 268 for category D.

Practical next step: Compare offers at the Strassenverkehrsamt Kanton Zürich website to see if you need to take any additional steps or exams before exchanging your US driving licence.
